definitions.explanation: Techniques and skills for protecting oneself from physical attack. Encompasses various martial arts and defensive methods.

examples.japanese: {護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I'm attending a self-defense class for women.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合気道|あいきどう}→合気道：17630_aikidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れている→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧。
examples.english: Aikido is also excellent as a form of self-defense.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers to the techniques themselves rather than the act of defending oneself. {護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (self-defense classes) are popular in Japan, especially classes designed for women.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧/⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn self-defense)
- {護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (self-defense class)
- {護身術|ごしんじゅつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as self-defense)

SIMILAR WORDS:
